purpose: 通过公开 API 观察取消后支付拒绝且 Error.message 为 null 时的失败记录、输出与补偿。
command: node --input-type=module -e "import {executeWorkflowAsync as run} from './src/engine.js'; import request from './examples/order-cancellation-input.mjs'; console.dir(await run(...request('reject-payment')), {depth:null});"

purpose: 通过同一公开触发输入观察已访问 end 的运行在业务成功后的微任务取消、终态和退款补偿。
command: node --input-type=module -e "import {executeWorkflowAsync as run} from './src/engine.js'; import request from './examples/order-cancellation-input.mjs'; console.dir(await run(...request('close-order')), {depth:null});"
